source_instruction: i'm looking for high waisted denim shorts distressed jeans for women.
query: I spent my entire Saturday morning helping my neighbor rescue her tiny tabby cat that got wedged in the slats of her old backyard fence, and by the time we got him out, he was purring so loud I could feel it through my work gloves, and she pressed a jar of her homemade wild blackberry jam into my hands as a thank you. I walked home with the jam tucked under my arm, stopped to watch a group of kids chase a monarch butterfly through the overgrown empty lot at the end of the block, and realized I’d forgotten to grab my favorite iced lavender latte from the corner coffee shop on my way back. I sat on my front porch for a bit after that, twisting open the jam jar to sneak a tiny taste with my finger, and watched a pair of robins hop across my lawn tugging worms out of the damp grass, and that’s when I remembered I needed to get my errand done before the afternoon thunderstorms rolled in. I’m browsing the women’s shorts section looking for a good pair to wear to weekend farmers markets and casual walks, y’know? I need them to have a button closure and be slim fit, since I hate when baggy shorts bunch up when I’m moving around. Oh, and they absolutely have to have a built-in reinforced loop for clipping on a reusable water bottle carabiner, that’s non-negotiable for me. I don’t want to spend a crazy amount, just a reasonable price that feels like a solid deal, nothing over what makes sense for everyday shorts. Can you pull up options that check all those boxes for me?
